modifier-key-tooltip: Hold this key and drag with the selection button to mark an area.
selection-button-tooltip: Used together with the modifier key to drag out a selection area.
stop-below-stamina-tooltip: Stops the queue when stamina drops below this value.
show-status-text-near-cursor-tooltip: Shows "N tiles selected / N workable" while drawing, and "N remaining" while working.
task-bubbles-tooltip: Shows an exclamation bubble over queued entities. Turning it off hides them immediately.
open-backpack-on-finish: Open Backpack When A Task Ends
auto-switch-debris-tools-tooltip: Boxing with a scythe, axe or pickaxe works the box per tile and switches tools along the way, then puts back the tool you held.
debris-chain-start: Auto tool switch: {{tools}} (switched along the way)
basic-sprinkler-layout-tooltip:
Default: a tight diagonal lattice that waters as many tiles as possible.
Trellis crops: the same diagonal skeleton, spaced out by "Sprinkler Spacing" below so
there is a walkable lane between coverage areas (mature trellis crops block the way).
A spacing of 0 makes both layouts identical.
sprinkler-spacing-tooltip:
Empty tiles between sprinkler coverage areas under the "Trellis Crops" layout.
0 = same as the default layout (no lane); 1 = lattice points 2 tiles apart, leaving a lane.
Only applies when the layout is set to "Trellis Crops", and only to basic sprinklers.
startup-log: Farm Queue loaded: hold {{modifier}} + {{button}} and drag a rectangle to queue work.
startup-keys: Arrow keys or switching items stop it
startup-can-refill: refills from a water source when empty,
startup-can-empty: stops when the can runs dry
startup-seeds: Seeds: drag over tilled empty soil, stops when they run out
startup-animals: Animals: empty hand pets, shears or the milk pail harvest then pet, the tool is switched to automatically, loose produce is picked up, unreachable animals are skipped
stop-no-work: Nothing to do in this area
stop-unknown-item: The held item has no matching action
nowork-no-map: The map isn't loaded yet ({{count}} tile(s))
nowork-occupied: Something is already on the tile ({{count}} tile(s))
nowork-resource-clump: Covered by a boulder or stump ({{count}} tile(s))
nowork-not-reachable: Tillable, but there's nowhere to stand ({{count}} tile(s))
nowork-not-selected: That kind of job is switched off in the settings ({{count}} tile(s))
nowork-not-sprinklered: Only sprinkler-covered soil is set to be tilled
nowork-bag-full: No bag room for machine output ({{count}} machine(s))
nowork-wrong-tool: The held tool can't do these jobs ({{count}} tile(s))
nowork-no-place: No free ground to place anything
nowork-nothing: Nothing for the held item to do
animal-not-ready: {{count}} animals: no produce, all petted today
animal-report-asleep: {{count}} animals are asleep — try again tomorrow morning
bag-full-skip: No bag room for machine output: {{count}} finished machine(s) skipped this run
